description: Search and compare hotels and other stays across providers. Call with stay details to start a search and read the first page; call again with only nextToken for the next page. The location must be an id from ktemia_lookup with kind='hotelLocation' - a free-text city name is not accepted. Ask the user for anything missing rather than guessing. A guessed city or date searches the wrong trip, spends quota, and returns confident nonsense. Tokens are opaque and expire one hour after the search starts. Page through with the nextToken from the previous page; when nextToken is absent there are no more pages. If a token has expired, start a new search rather than retrying the same token. Costs one API request against the account's monthly quota. Starting a search and reading each page are separate requests. Ktemia searches and compares. It does not book, hold, or pay for anything. Booking links in the results hand off to the provider's own site.

checkout.description: Check-out date as YYYY-MM-DD. Must be after checkin.

childAges.description: Ages of children sharing the room, as a list of years.

country.description: Two-letter market code to price in, for example 'US'. It selects the market, and prices come back in that country's currency. There is no currency parameter.

freeCancellation.description: Only rates that can be cancelled free of charge.

location.description: Location id from ktemia_lookup with kind='hotelLocation' - the locationId field of a result, for example '29230'.

nextToken.description: Read the next page of an existing search. When set, every other parameter is ignored.

providers.description: Restrict to these booking providers, using an id from availableFilters.bookingSites.options on a results page, for example 'Booking.com'. Guessed names match nothing.

name: ktemia_search_hotels
title: Search hotels and stays
